patch_description: Combines population-weighted cohort selection with adaptive terminal cleanup. It selects the balanced partition maximizing predicted population utility, constructs overlapping within-cohort cliques, and prunes cross-cohort ties. From time 93, completed actors return individually to original behavior while unfinished actors receive a bounded opportunity through time 95 to finish attainable cohort links. This targets incomplete recovery without prolonging forced construction for already-complete actors; the principal risk is that late additions may remain unfinished or temporarily costly.
